selection.method: energy-order greedy geometry representatives; window and cap applied after deduplication

limitations: Isolated-ligand MMFF94s energies only rank the input pool within one chemical state. ETKDG and greedy RMSD representatives do not guarantee exhaustive ring sampling. The graph is taken from experimental QDN, but all reference conformers are removed; no reference-coordinate conformer is injected and selection is receptor independent.
